newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mostly up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mostly up on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer on Tuesday, lifted by short-covering in lacklustre trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 1.6 yen firmer. Benchmark August contract was up 0.4 yen at 154.0 yen.
The market started the day higher across the board, with bullish sentiment carried over from the previous day.

But a caution that prices were too high, helped prices pare early gains after the benchmark August broke above 155.0 yen, the traders said. "Traders remained cautious about fresh buying," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
